scope: Local Windows Fuzzaldrin refinement experiments and final Lumine migration validation; timing and CPU profiles are separate runs.

method.productionRuns: Two independent final installed-dependency processes, both algorithms, no prototype replacement; a validation cohort, not interleaved with the earlier paired cohort.
method.pairedSnapshotDifference: Final library also trims the LRU before invoking score modifiers and requires an unchanged original query prefix when reusing zero Command-T scores, including when diacritic preparation erases case. Fuzzaldrin scoring unchanged. The 36-package sweep used refinementJavaScript; 343 focused specs and 1079026 differential comparisons were repeated against finalJavaScript.
method.workerLimitations: Diagnostic fixed-candidate Fuzzaldrin default ordering only. Browser workers are the accepted Electron transport; no production async API.
method.vscodeLimitations: Local pinned kernel adapter on ASCII candidates <=128 UTF-16 units. Different ranking/path behavior; not a correctness-equivalent replacement.
method.normalization: Candidate text and path metadata are prepared at insertion; each new query prepares only its own query text.
method.differentialScoreTolerance: max(1e-6, nativeScore * 1e-5); native tied results have no deterministic ordering contract.

profile.phase: General ASCII alignment before scalar two/three-character specialization
